game_title: The Lost Legacy of C · History/classification review
game_concept: A adventure race set in Shadow Cave – Echo Chamber, a booming echo chamber: the spelunker must handle skeleton miners while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Dam Filler: Raise the water level in a loop while level < max, without overflowing.
theme: Shadow Cave – Echo Chamber: a booming echo chamber
core_gameplay_loop: Search the archive, examine recovered computing artifacts, and use their evidence to verify the assigned C lesson.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Case 8: Find 5 artifacts, read the evidence, and verify three findings about History/classification review.
controls: Select objects in the room. Review discovered objects in Evidence and verify your findings. Tab and Enter select controls. Escape closes a card or pauses.
win_condition: Recover all 5 artifacts and answer all three evidence checks correctly.
lose_condition: The case ends when the available incorrect evidence checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared archive artwork, illustrated artifacts, and Kenney interface audio.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Dam Filler' (Week 4 slot 8), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Echo Chamber'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: Introduction to C: History, Characteristics and Classification

region.name: Shadow Cave
region.mood: echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Match the silhouettes in the tray to the objects in the room.
Inspect each artifact to read its history.
Open Evidence to review the records and verify your findings.
source_player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the crystal door by solving code steps involving level that move the spelunker forward.
source_win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.95).
source_lose_condition: The rival reaches the crystal door first, or lives reach 0.
hint: Match an unfound object in the tray to its shape in the room. The Evidence folder keeps every record you uncover.
